node.statement: Left-inversion homotopy. For U in calU_e set A(U):=mu(sigma(U),U). The covariance from lem-stage1-explicit-smooth-unitary-operations gives A(cU)=mu(conj(c)sigma(U),cU)=A(U), while (A_5) of lem-stage1-polar-constant-ledger gives ||A(U)-J||<=q. Thus (A_6) applies to (A(U),J), and P(t,[U]):=[H(t,A(U),J)] is a well-defined continuous homotopy from x |-> breve-mu(breve-sigma(x),x) to the constant breve-e. It is basepoint-preserving because A(J)=mu(sigma(J),J)=J and H(t,J,J)=J. Also breve-sigma(breve-e)=breve-e. Therefore breve-sigma is a left inversion map by def-h-space-left-inversion.
